public_note: These compact GDZ source-audit web drops were found in the Noether Multilingual lane and staged after the latest published Noether Zenodo version. They contain actionable source-confirmed findings, no-fix traps, and labelled witness crops for Papers 10, 11, and 12. They are not corrected cumulative TeX branches and not source-closure certifications.

files.quality_label: Noether Paper 10 targeted GDZ source-audit webdrop; actionable fixes/no-fix traps only
files.coverage: Paper 10, `Die Funktionalgleichungen der isomorphen Abbildung`, Math. Ann. 77 (1916), pp.536-545. The package includes a compact GDZ article PDF, IIIF manifest/provenance, labelled 1000dpi evidence crops, confirmed-fix CSV, no-fix-trap CSV, page map, image-dimension manifest, and checksums.
files.findings: Confirmed fixes: restore source-visible author line; replace terminal `k_\nu` with `k_\sigma` in definition (d); change `F(t;\vartheta)` to `F(t;\vartheta_i)` in the p541 divisibility display. No-fix traps include the final p545 variable `x`, the `\mp` sign pair, and footnote-count preservation.
files.next_action: Use as an audit/patch target for the next canonical German Noether TeX pass. Do not treat as applied TeX, translation, or complete Paper 10 closure.

files.coverage: Paper 11, `Gleichungen mit vorgeschriebener Gruppe`, Math. Ann. 78 (1918), pp.221-229. The package includes a GDZ article PDF, IIIF manifest/provenance, labelled 1000ppi witness crops, confirmed-fix CSV, no-fix-trap CSV, OmegaGamma occurrence ledger, witness-crop manifest, and checksums.
files.findings: Confirmed fixes: replace all 25 Paper 11 occurrences of `\mathfrak L_\Gamma` with source-visible `\Omega_\Gamma` inside the active Paper 11 block; restore source-visible author/front-matter line; change the final theorem punctuation from colon to semicolon. No-fix traps include formula (11) plain `G_k(x)` rather than `G'_k(x)`, the Tschirnhaus footnote coefficients, source spelling `Tschirnhausentransformation`, and preserving the original body reading `Zahlkoerper \Omega` unless adding a separate erratum/editorial note.
files.next_action: Use as an audit/patch target for the next canonical German Noether TeX pass. Do not treat as applied TeX, translation, or complete Paper 11 closure.
